Question: A regular hexagon with sides of length \(6\) has an isosceles triangle attached to each side. Each of these triangles has two sides of length \(8.\) The isosceles triangles are folded to make a pyramid with the hexagon as the base of the pyramid. What is the volume of the pyramid?
